content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The sovereign infrastructure replaces reliance on restrictive platforms with a robust stack designed for resilience and autonomy. Platforms like Gumroad impose high fees, taking up to 10% of every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This fee reduction translates directly into higher profits for creators. In an environment where payment rejections and financial isolation are common, owning your infrastructure means you can navigate these challenges effectively. Your store becomes a personal asset, not a rented space, and you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, ensuring diverse payment options for your customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you need a few essential tools. First, choose a hosting provider like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. For order storage, opt for Supabase or even Google Sheets if you're looking for simplicity. Lastly, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery. By assembling this infrastructure, you position yourself to deploy a fully functional online store that automatically processes Bitcoin payments and delivers products instantly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing a seamless payment and delivery pipeline is crucial. Integrate NOWPayments into your site for crypto payment processing, ensuring that transactions are secure and efficient. This service supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a minimal fee, allowing you to retain more revenue from each sale. Simultaneously, configure your delivery mechanism using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the distribution of ebooks upon payment confirmation. This automation not only enhances customer experience but also reduces the operational workload on your end.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping your profits intact.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to go live. Ensure your website is fully functional by testing all features, including payment processing and product delivery. When you're ready, promote your ebook through social media and other channels to attract customers. Monitor your first payment closely; with NOWPayments, you'll receive instant confirmations, allowing you to deliver your digital products without delay. This step solidifies your transition from planning to execution, showcasing the effectiveness of your self-sufficient sales model.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback to enhance your offerings, and consider adding more products to your catalog. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for access to advanced blueprints and templates that can further optimize your store’s performance. Explore promotional strategies to increase traffic and sales volume. As your customer base grows, ensure your infrastructure can handle increased demand seamlessly, allowing you to sustain and expand your business without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, set up your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Utilize free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Google Drive for product delivery. This approach keeps your costs minimal and your ownership complete, allowing you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly.
You own your infrastructure without needing to rely on third-party platforms.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to launch your digital store, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for a fully operational system. Explore further at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to see how you can build your own sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
